admission.capacityNote: Selection at the gate, capped at a maximum of 200 students a year. Four portfolio rounds close on 27 November, 15 January, 5 March and 15 May; interview invitations follow within two weeks of each. Places go as the rounds run, so the last round is the worst one to be in.

selection.description: A portfolio and an assignment specific to your chosen track — programming, game design, visual arts, or business and production — graded pass/fail at preselection.
An interview scored on motivation, communication, reflection, and the quality of the portfolio and assignment.
The cut-off point is set per discipline for each intake round, on applicant quality and the department's annual quota. There is no fixed standard to meet.

requirements.label: A full IB Diploma

officialWording.text: An equivalent of the Dutch diplomas of higher general secondary education (havo) or pre-university level (vwo) is generally required to enrol on a study programme at Breda University of Applied Sciences.

requirements.note: BUas's bar is a havo-OR-vwo equivalent, which is one level below what a Dutch research university needs, and the model has no requirement kind that says 'a qualification at this level'. It is recorded as a full IB Diploma because that is what this site's readers hold and because it certainly clears the bar. If you will hold IB Career-related Programme or Course Results rather than the Diploma, do not read this as a refusal: Nuffic compares the CP Certificate to at least a havo diploma and BUas's own English exemption list names it. Ask BUas directly.

requirements.label: Documented English proficiency

officialWording.text: You do not need to submit an English test if: [...] You hold an International Baccalaureate (IB) diploma, Career-related Programme Certificate of the IB, US High School diploma, GCE A(S) levels, or European Baccalaureate certificate (English Language 1 or 2).

requirements.note: An unconditional exemption, unlike TU Delft's and RSM's: BUas does not additionally require that English was an examination subject or that the programme was taught in English. Without it, the bar is IELTS Academic 6.0 with 6.0 in speaking, Cambridge 169, TOEFL iBT 80, PTE 61 or LanguageCert 65.

requirements.label: A portfolio and a track-specific assignment
requirements.note: A Selection Factor and the gate to everything else: BUas grades it pass/fail at preselection and only those who pass are interviewed. The assignment is issued when you apply, so it cannot be prepared in advance — but the portfolio can, and a year of work is visible in one.

officialWording.text: Preselection is based on the submission of an assignment and portfolio specific to each discipline, with a pass/fail grading system.

requirements.label: An interview on motivation, communication, reflection and skills
requirements.note: A Selection Factor. BUas publishes its own question guidelines, including how much time you spent on the assignment and what you would improve given more time.

requirements.label: A cut-off set per track for each round
requirements.note: A Selection Factor that is not a standard: "For each intake cycle, the cut-off point per discipline will be determined based on applicant quality and the department's annual quotas." Whether you are admitted depends on who else applied in your round.

officialRequirementsText.text: An equivalent of the Dutch diplomas of higher general secondary education (havo) or pre-university level (vwo) is generally required. The Creative Media and Game Technologies programme admits a maximum of 200 students each year through a selection procedure.

notes: BUas publishes no IB subject requirement for this programme. The admission pages were read on 2026-09-23 and set out only the diploma level and the English requirement; no examination subject is named. This is recorded as checked and absent rather than as unchecked — but 'no subject requirement' is not the same as 'you will get in', because every place here is allocated by selection.

A full IB Diploma is compared by Nuffic to a vwo diploma, and BUas offers a three-year track to applicants whose diploma is comparable to vwo. The standard hbo bachelor recorded on this programme is four years and 240 ECTS; the length of the short track was not established here, so it is not recorded as a credential.

Four rounds, not one deadline: 27 November, 15 January, 5 March and 15 May, each at 23:59 CET. The 15 January round is not the national numerus fixus deadline and missing it does not close the programme — but places are allocated as the rounds run and BUas says applying early secures a spot sooner.
The outcome arrives by 19 June, before IB results are published in early July.

The application step pages on the BUas website load their contents by script and returned nothing when read; the selection detail here comes from the regulation PDF adopted by the Executive Board on 25 August 2026 instead.
